text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian makes a comeback. Unfortunately, she has lost her edge. Hishi Amazon is shocked to see this new development.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing Narita Brian so frustrated shakes her to the core. Later, she heads to the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There, she catches Narita Brian and Symboli Rudolf on a partner run. Despite the substantial gap between the two, Narita Brian doesn't give up and doggedly tries to close the distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite everything, Narita Brian is as eager to run as ever, and Hishi Amazon is confident she will climb her way back to the top.
